notes: PB-14 (R-PROGRESSION-BETA, PR #407): words for the unlock screen and Sensei's Trial room. Words only, no art, no game code. Every 'line' is 8 words or fewer, first-grade reading level (the L&E Designer's standard: short common words, no word over three syllables apart from game names), no digits, no 'perfect', no pressure. 'title' is the real name shown above the line (Strike name, Seal rank name, or kata name); rank titles and numbers come from seal-families-text.json (PB-06, merged). The line says what the move does in kid words, never a stat dump. OVERLAP WITH THE #404 SEAL UNLOCK TIP: the equip tip ('Put this Seal in a slot.' / 'Then it helps you in fights.', drafts/learning/g2b-11-lock-breakfree-welcome-week.md) sits under the Seal name on the same screen. These lines do not repeat it: none says slot or equip, and none says it helps you in fights. A Seal screen reads title, rank line from here, then the #404 tip, so the two do not clash. Strikes #4-7 unlock lines are in strikes-4-7-text.json (R-G2B-16) and join this file at import. Kata power lines wait on Jay (PB-11): the placeholder line is the Manager-approved 'Power coming soon' idea.
